title: Prometheus Metric Metric Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prometheus:metric value_num=*
| stats sum(value_num) as total_value, avg(value_num) as avg_value by metric_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks metric values by total and average metric value across Prometheus metric events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `value_num` values for each Prometheus metric event and review total and average metric value by metric.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total metric value.
grandmaExplanation: It times which metric shows the biggest metric value numbers in your Prometheus metric data.
